title: Square names on the board
notes: Every square now shows its name — a1 to h8 — so you can always see where e4, f7 and the rest are.
Hover (or tap) a square name or a move like Nf3 in a lesson or the move list, and that square lights up on the board.
New "❓ How to read e4, Nf3…" button explains chess notation: piece letters, x for captures, + for check, # for mate, O-O for castling.
Prefer a clean board? Use "🔤 Hide square names" under any board.
